Chapter 6755: Public Outrage

Chapter 6755: Public Outrage

“But this lifeform, she, stands before you.” Li Qiye glanced at the girl.

“Someone would have known if such a lifeform had been born in Divine Firmament.” Xiaoyue remarked.

“Then how did she appear here?” He smiled.

Xiaoyue stared at the girl, wondering about all the possibilities.

“Thus, did Qing Ji leave Divine Firmament just to join Immortal Hunt?” He asked.

“I know Qing Ji did join the alliance.” She hesitated before answering.

“I trust this is accurate. Then why did he join? To eat immortals?” He asked.

“Hmm...” She pondered.

“Of course, I was not there, so I’m limited to speculations. Anything is possible with speculations, but her existence is real.” He said.

“Young Noble, are you saying that Qing Ji brought her here?” Her eyes narrowed.

“Possibly. Only Divine Firmament knows what happened back then. Of course, they wouldn’t reveal it to outsiders, right?” He said.

Her expression changed slightly but she didn’t respond.

“Looks like Qing Ji did a few things that couldn’t be publicized.” He said.

“If Divine Firmament had known, they would have crushed him before Empress Hong Tian.” She said.

“Provoked everyone’s wrath, I see.” He smiled.

“He had no one else with him, no other lifeform.” She sighed.

“I should not doubt your certainty.” He said: “The clues point to her being born in Divine Firmament. As for how she got here, that’s hard to say. Just more coincidences, right?”

“Yes.” She sighed.

“So pardon my nosiness, but what did Qing Ji do?” He asked.

“I do not know, Divine Firmament never released information about this matter.” She said, clearly not wanting to dwell on it.

“Must be something sensitive for Divine Firmament.” He said: “I’m a bit interested in her, let’s take a look.”

“Let it revert to its true form?” She asked.

“No, a quick manifestation will suffice. If she is hiding here, we will let her out of respect for all life.” He said.

She stared at him upon hearing this.

“Although immortals view everything as trash, there are things more valuable than their so-called treasures, such as love.” He continued.

“Thank you for your lesson.” She bowed.

“Start.” He ordered.

She came closer to the girl, alarming the lord. He instinctively wanted to shield her but didn’t wish to cause trouble.

“Immortal.” He asked Li Qiye for help since the command came from him.

“Don’t worry, I already agreed to spare her, just watch.” Li Qiye said.

He heaved a sigh of relief, believing immortals would always stay true to their words.

“A look it is.” Xiaoyue sighed and placed her hand on the girl’s forehead.

“Buzz.” She released an immortal light of the primordial nature, enveloping the girl instead of dispersing.

The lord had never seen an ancient ancestor, let alone an immortal. He could see that a tiny strand from this light could obliterate his daughter and kingdom. Thus, the potential volatility horrified him.

“Clank!” A metallic noise echoed as if her body was being opened.

Strange golden runes of varying sizes appeared on her, converging and forming primary meridians.

She resembled a universe with bright stars and naturally, black holes.

“Gather!” Xiaoyue uttered a forceful command, gathering the black holes into her forehead.

“Ahh!” This prompted the girl to scream.

A monstrous power erupted from within, enough to destroy all of Beastmaster World. Fortunately, Xiaoyue kept it under control with a seal.

Nevertheless, the lord was astounded by his daughter’s incredible power.
